overviewHtml:
Built-in workflow actions don't cover every case, and writing custom JavaScript for the Run JavaScript action from scratch takes time that teams would rather spend elsewhere.

What you get

  • Code snippets for the Run JavaScript action
  • Examples that use SDK calls for settings, entities and synthetic monitors
  • A copy-and-paste approach that needs no setup beyond permissions
  • Snippets that you can adapt to your own logic
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • The permissions that each snippet's SDK calls need, for example settings:objects:read for settings, and the permissions to read entities and run synthetic monitors
setupHtml:
1. In your workflow, add a task and choose Run JavaScript.
  2. Paste the snippet into the task.
  3. Run the workflow and check the task result.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows and the permissions each snippet's SDK calls require.

  1. Add a Run JavaScript task to your workflow
  2. Paste the snippet
  3. Run the workflow and check the result
